sketches.resonance: A container that, whenever you search for something absent, quietly creates it — the way memory fills gaps with longing.

sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining silently returns nil when any link in the chain is absent, collapsing the entire expression to nothing
sketches.resonance: Every attempt to reach deeper into what's gone yields the same silence — the question mark asks and asks but never arrives.

sketches.mechanism: A process that sends a message to itself after dying — but receive blocks forever because dead processes cannot deliver
sketches.resonance: The last act is to reach out, but there is no one left to hear; the mailbox outlives the voice.
sketches.draft:
farewell() ->
    Self = self(),
    spawn(fun() ->
        Ref = monitor(process, Self),
        receive {'DOWN', Ref, _, _, _} -> Self ! remember end
    end),
    exit(gone).
